def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # body_mass_g stored as text, some with thousands separators
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # flipper_length_mm stored as text with negative (invalid) values
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['flipper_length_mm'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    # sex label variant: trailing space
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.strip().replace({'nan': pd.NA})
    # enforce allowed ranges where rules exist
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    df.loc[(df['bill_length_mm'] < 30) | (df['bill_length_mm'] > 60), 'bill_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    return d.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].sum().to_dict()
